title: Derived ringed-topos counit under coefficient restriction
statement:
Let $f:\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal X)\to\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal Y)$ be a morphism of topoi presented by small sites [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $A$ be a commutative ring, let $A_X,A_Y$ be its constant ring sheaves [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and identify $f^{-1}A_Y=A_X$. Let $R_X,R_Y$ be sheaves of commutative $A_X,A_Y$-algebras, with a compatible structural map $c:f^{-1}R_Y\to R_X$. Write $D(A_W),D(R_W)$ for the ordinary unbounded derived categories of module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $U_W:D(R_W)\to D(A_W)$ for exact coefficient restriction [def-pc-sheaf-restrict-scalars]. Let $Q_A=f^{-1}$ on constant-$A$ complexes and $Q_R=Lf_R^*$ be derived module pullback along $c$, computed with flat-term K-flat resolutions [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]. Let $F_A=Rf_{*,A}$ and $F_R=Rf_{*,R}$ be K-injective derived direct images, with the canonical derived module adjunctions and counits $\varepsilon_A,\varepsilon_R$ [def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-arrows].

Let $\kappa:U_YF_R\xrightarrow{\sim}F_AU_X$ be the canonical comparison of the two factorizations of $(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal X),R_X)\to(\operatorname{Sh}(\mathcal Y),A_Y)$, normalized by the K-injective derived-composition maps of [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition]. Let $\tau:Q_AU_Y\to U_XQ_R$ be the canonical scalar-unit comparison: for a flat-term K-flat $R_Y$-complex $P$ it is the class of the degreewise map $f^{-1}U_YP\to U_X(R_X\otimes_{f^{-1}R_Y}f^{-1}P)$ sending $x$ to $1\otimes x$, with the canonical resolution identifications. Then for every $K\in D(R_X)$ one has the equality in $D(A_X)$
$$U_X(\varepsilon_{R,K})\circ\tau_{F_RK}=\varepsilon_{A,U_XK}\circ Q_A(\kappa_K).$$
The comparisons are natural in $K$ and in compatible homomorphisms of the $A$-algebra sheaves. No boundedness, flatness of $A_W\to R_W$, adic completeness, or constructibility hypothesis is imposed.

source.place: Agent consequence of Tag 0D6E (lemma-derived-pushforward-composition) and Tag 07A6 (lemma-adjoint), with the ordinary tensor adjunction of Tag 03D7 (sites-modules, lemma-adjoint-pullback-pushforward-modules): counit normalization for the two factorizations through constant coefficients.

proof.text: Apply [lem-pur-ringed-coefficient-derived-presentation-exists] to the ordinary presentation. This supplies existence only; the following representative calculation proves the counit square for any presentation, independently of how it was constructed.

Apply the faithful underlying sheaf functor to the ordinary adjunction formulas. Cancel the invertible pushAUnderlying comparison and substitute ordinaryKappaFormula, scalarUnitFormula and inverseRestrictionFormula. The remaining equation is adjRFormula. Degreewise this gives ordinaryComplexTranspose. For p, kappaFormula, naturality of yFactors and cancellation of the resolution j give localizedKappaEquation. Apply the constant derived Hom formula to j after scalarUnit after a chain map f; the ordinary transpose equation and tauFormula identify its inverse adjunct with tau followed by x of the R-derived inverse adjunct. This is derivedTransposeOnRepresentative. All these equalities are proved directly from the presentation fields.

For a K-injective I choose a K-injective resolution j of restriction(aX)(I), and a flat-term K-flat resolution q:P to pushR(I). The site tensor comparison converts categorical flatness to flatness on the site. Apply derivedTransposeOnRepresentative to the ordinary inverse adjunct of q, and use r.homFormula. The map h=Q(q) followed by r.eta(I) is invertible. Precompose both sides of the counit square by a.left(y(h)); expand inverse adjuncts as images followed by counits, and use naturality of tau. Cancellation of this invertible map proves counitOnInjective.

Every derived object is isomorphic to Q(I) for K-injective I. The free sheaf on each shrink-Yoneda representable forms a separating family by the free/sheafification adjunction; its coproduct and exact filtered colimits prove Grothendieck abelianness in the coefficient universe, giving the required K-injective resolutions. Transport counitOnInjective along the representing isomorphism using naturality of tau, kappa and both counits. This proves CounitCompatibility for every presentation.

For compatible coefficient maps apply [lem-pur-ringed-coefficient-change-normalization]. Its hypotheses CounitCompatibility for p and p prime have both just been proved, using the same representative argument. This gives the existence of CoefficientChange and the naturality of every normalized change, completing the conjunction.

reviewed.note: mechanical checks by tools/merge_delivery.py; mathematics reviewed in full by NT-cc-Q59-e9a9d904f (reviewer sub-agent of L); spot-checked: The item's statement is true; I checked it independently. For a K-injective I with K-flat q:P->f_*I, U_X(eps_R)∘tau is the class of the abelian counit e. Its Q_A-|F_A adjunct is f_*(j) by the triangle identity, which is the K-injective normalization of kappa in lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition (Stacks 0D6E, sites-cohomology l.4011). Edge cases f=id, R=A, K=0, zero ring and non-flat A->A/I all pass. No duplicate: the closest node, lem-weil-pbc-ring-sheaf-change-adjunction, only covers pro-etale sites with isomorphic coefficient maps. The item is not a restated clause of its parent lem-pur-ordinary-adjunction-scalar-compatibility; its Step 6 uses the item at exactly this generality. Steps 2 and 4 (now 5) were correct; the Tag 0037 counit identity is a Mathlib leaf. Repaired faults: (1) E4/E5 in Step 3: it evaluated at Q_R P with P resolving the argument of Q_R instead of a K-flat resolution of F_R K. It waved off arbitrary objects as 'the same calculation' and did not cite the representative characterization of derived adjuncts (lem-pc-pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general, 0FND). I rewrote it as Steps 3-4: eps_R represented by s⊗x->s·e(f^{-1}q x), so phi=Q(e); its adjunct is Q(f_*j)=kappa_K. (2) E5 in Step 1: 'transports' replaced by an explicit proof that tau is well defined (exact U_W and f^{-1}, K-flat resolutions [lem-pc-kflat-resolution], quasi-isomorphism preservation [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pullback]). Also added a reason for naturality in algebra maps; proof_deps recomputed. Cycle check: the 222 nodes reachable from the added citations do not include the item. Tool uses accepted: module-adjunction (03D7), derived-tensor-pullback, projection-formula-arrows (definition), pushforward-composition (0D6E); added pre-derived-adjoint-functors-general, kflat-resolution and ringed-topoi-derived-pullback.
